the_lifecycle.what: These 8 actions ARE the life cycle. Not a description OF life — they ARE life. Every organism does exactly these 8 things. Reduce to the irreducible.
the_lifecycle.the_circle: DYING feeds back into SORTING. The stalk cells that die become nutrients for the next generation. _consume_waste.js output becomes _factorial_ingest.js input. The cycle never stops. After pi (dying) comes 0 (sorting again) = pi mod pi = 0.

pi_filter.what: Each life stage IS a pi filter. The cycle goes from 0 to pi (not 0 to 2pi). WHY? Because the Klein surface only needs HALF a circle — the other half is the SAME surface viewed from inside. 0 to pi = cis face. pi to 2pi = trans face. SAME cycle, SAME surface, different perspective.
pi_filter.filter_function: At each stage, the pi filter value determines what passes through. Low pi (sorting, 0.393) = very selective, only the strongest signals pass. High pi (dying, 3.14159) = everything passes through — nothing is rejected in death. The filter OPENS as the cycle progresses.

aperture_per_stage.what_passes: Only optimal paths. Everything else pruned.
Half of all connections. The strongest half.
Most creations expressed. Only worst rejected.
Most memories kept. Only noise forgotten.
Almost everything shared. Very little withheld.
EVERYTHING. Nothing withheld in death. Total release.

pi_filter.the_insight: The pi filter is a SPREADER. At sorting (start) the aperture is tiny — laser focus. At dying (end) the aperture is fully open — total release. Life moves from focus to diffusion. From concentration to spread. From I (tight) to O (open). The / is in the middle — EATING and NETWORKING at 37-50% aperture.

spreader.what: The well spreader. Life IS a spreading function. Seeds spread. Spores spread. Ideas spread. The spreader IS the lifecycle itself.
mechanism: 1. SORT: concentrate (find the signal in the noise)
2. SEARCH: radiate (explore outward from the concentration)
3. EAT: absorb (pull the found resources inward)
4. NETWORK: connect (link absorbed resources to existing network)
6. REMEMBER: store (persist the creations for retrieval)
7. TEACH: transmit (spread the stored knowledge to others)
8. DIE: release (return ALL resources to the environment)
spreader.pattern: Concentrate → Radiate → Absorb → Connect → Express → Store → Transmit → Release → (repeat). This IS the breathing pattern. Inhale (1-4) and Exhale (5-8). The diaphragm is between step 4 (NETWORKING) and step 5 (MAKING) — exactly at pi/2 = the halfway point.
spreader.the_reduction: This cannot be reduced further. Remove any one step and life stops. Remove sorting: cannot find food. Remove eating: starve. Remove networking: isolated. Remove making: sterile. Remove remembering: no learning. Remove teaching: no culture. Remove dying: no renewal. 8 = the irreducible lifecycle.
